svg.title: domain-flipper-agent
svg.desc: Multi-agent. 1:1 MCP server per service. LangGraph agents read trends from the open web, generate and value domain names, check trademarks and availability, then stop and wait for a human to approve before acting. Built with Python, LangGraph, Claude API, FastMCP, Postgres.

g.text: LangGraph agents read trends from the open web, generate and
value domain names, check trademarks and availability, then stop
and wait for a human to approve before acting.
